FN-MCF6H11-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 5
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/14/2025
Senate Bill 5 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Department of Archives and
History by an estimated $353 per board meeting to reimburse the per diem and travel expenses,
if claimed, of the two additional members appointed to the board pursuant to this bill. However,
according to the department historically, board members have not claimed per diem and travel
expenses.
Page 1
